bear_assumptions: Annualized USD 0.68 reported Q2 EPS at 12x as copper normalizes, Grasberg restoration slows and idle or restoration costs persist.
base_assumptions: Annualized USD 0.74 adjusted Q2 EPS at 16x as the stated Grasberg ramp proceeds but production remains below normal and Indonesian and minority economics retain a discount.
bull_assumptions: Annualized USD 0.74 adjusted Q2 EPS at 22x as copper pricing stays elevated, recovery executes safely, costs remain controlled and Indonesian operating rights advance.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if a fresh mark and current primary evidence restore positive base and confidence-adjusted expected returns, payoff asymmetry and margin of safety; downgrade on a Grasberg recovery setback, copper-price normalization, higher costs or capex, weaker Indonesian terms, a safety event or deteriorating cash conversion.
